page.overview:
Who is Larissa Lyndel?

Larissa Lyndel was an Aes Sedai from the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was a bony woman whose "plainness almost overcame Aes Sedai age-lessness".

Larissa is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she would have an above-average ability in Healing.
